Plain PHP; manual test http://localhost:8080 or http://localhost/. PHP 8.2/Apache, MySQL 8.0; env credentials; web/db; ports 8080/3306.

PascalCase classes; controllers end Controller; singular models; camelCase methods/variables/properties; UPPER_SNAKE_CASE constants; snake_case tables/columns; lowercase_underscore views. Class files must match class names exactly. 4 spaces, same-line `{`, standalone `}`, spaces after keywords, no trailing whitespace, blank line between methods, 120-character soft limit; no strict types.

Use `require_once` with `__DIR__`; dependencies first:
require_once __DIR__ . '/../config/database.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../models/User.php';

Always validate and sanitize user input; trim, validate email/length. Use PDO::FETCH_ASSOC, prepared statements, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION, try-catch/PDOException, generic model exceptions, validation arrays; never expose raw database errors. Use `lastInsertId()`, `rowCount()`, and user_id isolation. SQL Injection: Always use prepared statements with PDO, never concatenate queries. XSS Prevention: Always escape output with `htmlspecialchars()` when displaying user data. Password Storage: Use `password_hash()` and `password_verify()` (never md5/sha1). CSRF Protection: Not currently implemented, but recommended for production.

Controllers check `$_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD']`, authenticate, validate, use models. Redirects: Always use `header('Location: ...')` followed by `exit;` to prevent code execution. Views include layout, escape output, use `??`, no business logic. Start session in index.php; store user ID/username; destroy logout; never store passwords in session. Singleton Database, UTF-8, graceful errors. Implement schema.sql, models/, controllers/, views/, index.php, public/css/style.css; test success/error paths. Use `in_array()` for enums.
